name: Klaven's Tower
summary: In southeastern Westfall, Klaven's Tower guards a river crossing near the kingdom's borders. Klaven Mortwake commands the tower, where stolen goods pass along Defias routes.

sections.title: A Smuggler's Stronghold
sections.body:
North of the Dagger Hills, Klaven's Tower anchors the Defias Brotherhood's work in southern Westfall. Across the river in Elwynn Forest, Jerod's Landing receives and stages goods plundered from the Redridge Mountains. Together, the two sites move contraband toward Westfall.

From the tower, the Brotherhood watches the waterways and slips supplies past Kingdom patrols. This helps shield its supply routes from the crown's eyes.

sections.title: Fumes and Shadows
sections.body:
Klaven Mortwake controls the tower. An alchemist and rogue, he spends his hours brewing exotic troll poisons within its walls. Thick, noxious fumes fill the upper chambers.

The vapors are deadly to intruders, but they also dull the senses of Mortwake's own guards. That weakness gives Stormwind's intelligence service, SI:7, a blind spot to exploit as its agents monitor the tower from nearby hills.

faq.answer: Klaven Mortwake, a Defias rogue, controls the tower. He oversees smuggling and experiments with volatile poisons. Defias sentries and patrollers guard the grounds under his command.

faq.q: Why is the tower important to the Defias Brotherhood?
aliases: what is this tower used for
faq.answer: The tower relays stolen goods moving into Westfall. Cargo from the Redridge Mountains crosses Elwynn Forest, passes Jerod's Landing, then reaches the tower to supply the Brotherhood's wider rebellion.

faq.q: Why is SI:7 watching this place?
faq.answer: Stormwind intelligence watches the tower because of Mortwake's poison-making and its central place in Defias supply routes. Master Mathias Shaw leads the service, and operatives like Amber Kearnen scout the perimeter to assess Brotherhood movements and seize valuable intelligence.

faq.q: What are the fumes lingering inside the tower?
faq.answer: The haze comes from Klaven Mortwake's experiments with troll poisons. The protected section describes their effects on the tower's guards.

angles.text: As a rogue trained in Stormwind, you come to Klaven's Tower at SI:7's direction. You infiltrate Mortwake's stronghold, test your lockpicking and stealth, and learn the dangerous craft of virulent poisons.
Near the borders of Elwynn, Westfall, and Redridge, this Defias stronghold shows how deeply the Brotherhood has compromised the kingdom's interior riverways and trade routes.
